title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. 

 

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern frontend applications across multiple product areas. You will work on distributed systems, cloud-native services, high-volume data processing, and web crawling operations while collaborating closely with QA, DevOps, Product, and Architecture teams.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in .NET / C#, Angular, Azure, Docker/Kubernetes, and modern software engineering practices, along with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and mentor junior engineers.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using .NET / C#

• Build and maintain modern frontend applications using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SCSS

• Work with Node.js and React where required across different product areas

• Develop and optimize distributed systems for high-volume data processing and web crawling operations

• Design, build, and maintain cloud-native applications and services in Azure

• Manage containerized deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

• Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps

• Write clean, maintainable, testable, and high-performance code

• Develop unit tests and ensure strong test coverage across applications

• Investigate and troubleshoot complex production issues across application, infrastructure, and network layers

• Collaborate closely with QA, DevOps, Product, and Architecture teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions

• Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering best practices

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the technical growth of the team

Required Skills & Experience

• 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering or similar senior development roles

• Strong hands-on experience with .NET / C#, Angular and NoSQL databases.

• Strong experience in Angular and frontend application development

• Good working knowledge of Node.js, React, TypeScript, and JavaScript

• Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and SCSS

• Strong experience working with Azure cloud services

• Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AKS

• Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipeline implementation

• Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture and scalable system design

• Excellent debugging, performance tuning, and problem-solving skills

• Deep knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, REST APIs, sessions, cookies, headers, authentication flows, proxies, and browser behavior

• Strong understanding of website rendering, DOM structure, JavaScript execution, and page lifecycle

• Strong networking knowledge including DNS, SSL/TLS, caching, load balancing, reverse proxies, and traffic flow

Good to Have

• Experience in web crawling, scraping, browser automation, and content extraction systems

• Strong understanding of how websites work behind the scenes

• Experience handling anti-bot protections, crawling optimization, and large-scale data extraction systems

• Exposure to performance monitoring, logging, tracing, and production diagnostics in distributed environments

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
